Tomoko Akane is a judge from Japan who became ICC president in 2024.

The Trump administration is engaged in a campaign regarding the ICC.
latest_clusters.synthesis: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has announced sanctions against ICC President Tomoko Akane and Senior Trial Lawyer Abdoulaye Seye as part of an effort to challenge the court's jurisdiction. The sanctions are described by administration officials as a protection of US sovereignty, while other outlets identify the move as a response to the court's investigations into specific international conflicts.
